Name: Fruit Hats
Author: peawies
Description:
This mod adds [b]Fruit Hats[/b] to Stardew Valley. And guess what? They look like fruits![i]

[/i]Here is how to obtain them:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Pineapple Hat can be traded from Island Trader for 123 Pineapples.
[*]Banana Hat can be traded from Island Trader for 234 Bananas.
[*]Coconut Hat can be traded from Desert Trader for 48 Coconuts.
[*]Cactus Hat can be traded from Sandy for 89 Cactus Fruits.
[*]Powdermelon Hat can be traded from Traveling Merchant in Festival of Ice for 206 Powdermelons.
[*]Orange Hat can be traded from Pierre in Spirit's Eve for 666 Oranges.
[*]Melon Hat can be traded from Traveling Cart for 254 Melons. (Hat has a 50% chance to appear in her stock)
[/list]The reason I wanted to make these hats obtainable with trades instead of coins is because nearly all other hats are purchased with coins and you gotta learn that money is not always the solution.[/spoiler]

[size=3][b]Translation[/b][/size]
Hats' names and descriptions are supported in all languages supported by the game.

[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
The mod is probably compatible with other mods too.
